title: Bitcoin Price Rebounds Near $64,000 as Anthropic IPO Lifts Tech Stocks
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Rebounds Near $64,000 as Anthropic IPO Lifts Tech Stocks The bitcoin price climbed back to near $63,700 on Thursday morning as Anthropic's record IPO lifted tech stocks, though ETF outflows and Fed hike risk kept gains in check. This post Bitcoin Price Rebounds Near $64,000 as Anthropic IPO Lifts Tech Stocks first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
